records.title: After-Sales system purpose
records.text: The After-Sales project is described as an operations management system, not just a ticketing system. It covers invoices, products, services, warehouses, operational teams, appointments, technicians, delivery, installation, manufacturing, measurement, internal transfers, maintenance, customer rating, and tracking for each stage.

records.title: SAP and Odoo roles
records.text: SAP is the commercial source for customer sales, invoices, products, and services. Odoo is the operational system for creating, managing, and tracking after-sales service execution.

records.title: High-level after-sales flow
records.text: The high-level flow is Customer to SAP sale or invoice, then data moves to Odoo, then Odoo creates and follows after-sales services, operational teams execute the service, the service is closed, and the customer rates the service.

records.title: SAP invoice combinations
records.text: A SAP invoice may contain products only, product plus service, multiple products plus one service, multiple products plus multiple services, Delivery only, Delivery plus Installation, Manufacturing, Measurement, Design, or other combinations.

records.title: Product-service relationship gap
records.text: The source describes a disagreement with the Odoo team: the team indicated service-to-product linking could not be automated because no direct relationship was present in SAP data. The user objected that manual linking should not be required every time.

records.title: Required SAP product-service mapping
records.text: The required future behavior is a clear integration and data mapping from SAP so Odoo knows which products are linked to which services, such as Product A to Installation, Product B to Delivery plus Installation, and Product C to Manufacturing plus Installation.

records.title: Service invoice to product invoice relationship
records.text: When product and service invoices are separate, the system needs to know the relationship from Service Invoice to Original Product Invoice and from Service Line to Product Line.

records.title: Observed SAP billing types
records.text: Observed SAP billing type examples include ZMF2 as After Sales Invoice, ZRE as Return Case, and ZS2 or ZS9 as Service Invoice. Billing type may act as a trigger for the type of case Odoo should open.

records.title: ZCF2 handling is unresolved
records.text: The meaning and handling of SAP billing type ZCF2 was not finalized in the available project context.

records.title: Sales office to branch and team mapping
records.text: SAP fields such as Sales Organization, Distribution Channel, and Sales Office should allow Odoo to identify the responsible branch, After Sales Team, and Operational Team.

records.title: Sales office examples and incomplete mapping
records.text: Sales Office examples mentioned include RYD1, JED1, DMM1, and PRJ1, with JED1 mapped as an example to Jeddah After Sales Team. The full real Sales Office mapping table remains incomplete.

records.title: After Sales Request and team models
records.text: The Odoo module included model or screen names close to after_sales_request and after_sales_team, suggesting a design based on After Sales Request, Service or Tasks, Team, and Execution, with separate models for some services.

records.title: Service Identification
records.text: The system must identify the services present on the invoice received from SAP.

records.title: Product-Service Relationship
records.text: The system must know which product or invoice line is linked to each service.

records.title: Delivery Only
records.text: If the invoice contains Delivery only, the system should allow delivery appointment booking and execution without Installation validation.

records.title: Delivery plus Installation
records.text: If the invoice contains Delivery plus Installation, required installation path or appointment rules apply before delivery progresses.

records.title: Technician Conflict
records.text: The system should not allow booking a technician in overlapping appointments.

records.title: Travel Buffer
records.text: A time buffer should exist between technician appointments; the example discussed was 30 minutes between the end of one appointment and the start of the next.

records.title: Product Readiness
records.text: The system should verify that the required goods are ready before execution according to service type.

records.title: Partial Completion
records.text: The system should allow part of a service to be executed while retaining the remaining quantity, such as 20 meters installed from 30 meters with 10 meters remaining.

records.title: Follow-up Priority
records.text: Requests marked for completion later should have higher priority when booking the later completion appointment.

records.title: Returns
records.text: Returning a product should not affect a service that is not linked to that returned product.

records.title: Operational Team Assignment
records.text: Operational Team should be determined by Warehouse plus Service plus Location or Branch rules.

records.title: Missing Mapping
records.text: If no suitable mapping exists, the case should show a clear exception instead of being left without a responsible owner.

records.title: No eligible Operational Team configured
records.text: A UAT issue was observed with the error No eligible Operational Team is configured for this Warehouse and service. The task existed, but Odoo could not assign an eligible team based on Warehouse, Service, and Operational Team configuration.
relatedTerms: No eligible Operational Team is configured for this Warehouse and service

records.title: INV/2026/00108 team assignment failure
records.text: UAT example INV/2026/00108 - 1 used Delivery service, Warehouse مستودع الأدوات الصحية – الرياض, and SAP Collection Code R502. The result was Hcos Team Assignment equals No Eligible Team.

records.title: UAT Scenario 1 product plus one service
records.text: UAT Scenario 1 covered Product plus one service. Service creation succeeded. The historical example references 4213030704 / 8213025276.

records.title: UAT Scenario 2 multiple services
records.text: UAT Scenario 2 covered multiple services, specifically Delivery plus Installation, with example 4213030705 / 8213025277. The focus was flow ordering and validation between delivery and installation.

records.title: UAT Scenario 3 partial installation
records.text: UAT Scenario 3 covered Partial Installation with example 4114207747 / 8114159138. The target was executing part of the service and completing it later.

records.title: UAT Scenario 5 Delivery Only
records.text: UAT Scenario 5 covered Delivery Only. Multiple invoices were used during testing, including changing targets INV/2026/00111 - 1 and later INV/2026/00123 - 1.

records.title: Playwright UAT automation scope
records.text: UAT automation was started with Playwright under a project named approximately odoo UAT and test tests/delivery-flow.spec.ts. The initial requested scope was read-only: login, open خدمة التوصيل, search invoice or task, open task, and verify data.

records.title: Playwright automation locator issues
records.text: Automation issues included Project card not found, Task not found, and Strict mode duplicate locator. Some text appeared in multiple places such as search facets and task cards, so locators were adjusted to use Arabic text like خدمة التوصيل and stage طلب توصيل.

records.title: Customer rating flow
records.text: The customer rating mobile web flow is Service Completed, customer receives rating link, four questions, suggestions, submit, and thank you.

records.title: Customer rating questions
records.text: The final rating questions are: كيف تقيم تعامل مقدم الخدمة واحترافيته؟ كيف تقيم جودة العمل؟ كيف تقيم الالتزام بالموعد؟ كيف تقيم تجربتك بشكل عام مع الخدمة؟

records.title: Rating should link to service record
records.text: The rating result should return to Odoo and link to the Service Record, including service task, customer, rating answers, general comment, and final suggestions.

records.title: Customer rating reporting possibilities
records.text: Management could later report rating by service, team, technician, recurring problems, weak branches, and average customer satisfaction.

records.title: AI over calls, tickets, service history, and ratings
records.text: A proposed expanded idea is for AI to learn from Odoo calls, tickets, after-sales history, service cases, and ratings to classify, summarize, and build knowledge.

records.title: AI recurring issue and low rating analysis
records.text: Potential AI analysis includes identifying the most recurring issue in installation service, why customers give low ratings, and summarizing customer calls into Odoo.

records.title: WhatsApp reply to business action
records.text: A proposed WhatsApp flow is customer reply, Odoo receives event or message, business rule, and action. For example, موافق could confirm an appointment, while غير مناسب could open rescheduling, depending on the WhatsApp integration used.

records.title: Complete Sales Office mapping table
records.text: The real mapping table for every Sales Office must be completed. If a new Sales Office arrives without mapping, an invoice may enter Odoo without a responsible team.

records.title: Service cancellation behavior for returned products
records.text: When a returned product is linked to a service, the system needs business rules for what happens to the related service. The source states this must be decided by business rule and should not automatically cancel all invoice services.

records.title: Service-specific stages need finalization
records.text: The project needs richer stages than Pending, In Progress, and Done, such as New, Waiting for Customer, Appointment Booked, Ready, In Progress, Partial or تكملة لاحقًا, and Done. Some services need stages different from others.

records.title: Educational site service training scope
records.text: The educational HTML site is intended to explain Customer Journey, Business Flow, Business Rules, and System Actions for each service, starting with delivery and a guided overview. This is a project direction rather than a confirmed operational rule.

records.title: Core after-sales relationship chain
records.text: The core relationship chain is Customer, SAP Invoice, Invoice Line, Product, Service, Warehouse, Operational Team, Appointment, Technician, Execution, Partial or Complete, and Customer Rating.

records.title: Target system relationship map
records.text: The target system map places SAP Sales or Invoice as the source of Products and Services, linked by Product-Service mapping, flowing into Odoo After Sales Request, Branch, Warehouse, Service Type, Operational Team, Service Task, Appointment, Technician, Products, Execution, Partial or Done, Customer Rating, Reports and Analytics, and AI calls or tickets analysis.

records.title: Service end-to-end map
records.text: At a high level, customer purchase from SAP leads to invoice or request, then design, measurement, or direct service paths. Design and measurement can lead to manufacturing, then goods readiness, internal transfer when needed, delivery, installation, completion or completion later with a new appointment, and customer rating. After execution, customer issues can lead to Field Maintenance, technician or appointment, resolution, and rating.

records.title: Service dependencies
records.text: Supported service dependencies include Measurement to Manufacturing, Manufacturing to Readiness, Readiness to Delivery, and Delivery to Installation. Internal Transfer may occur before delivery or installation when needed for readiness.

records.title: Delivery service scope
records.text: Delivery is one of the core After-Sales services. If an invoice contains a Delivery service, the system is expected to create a Delivery Task in Odoo.

records.title: Delivery Only flow
records.text: For a Delivery Only invoice, the user wanted the system to allow booking the delivery appointment directly without installation-specific validation.

records.title: Delivery plus Installation dependency
records.text: For invoices containing Delivery plus Installation, delivery should not progress as if it were Delivery Only. The discussed rule was that the installation appointment must be booked before delivery can continue.

records.title: Delivery stage blocked until installation appointment is booked
records.text: A UAT error was observed: This delivery task cannot change stage until the customer has booked the installation appointment. This indicates validation tying delivery task stage progress to an installation appointment booking.
relatedTerms: This delivery task cannot change stage until the customer has booked the installation appointment

records.title: Delivery execution elements
records.text: Delivery execution knowledge includes appointment booking, appointment window, driver assignment, Task Forms, driver portal, Start, photo upload, End Task, OTP, and Completed.

records.title: Delivery team assignment should be rule-based
records.text: Delivery operational team assignment should be based on Warehouse plus Service Type plus Branch or Region, for example Riyadh Warehouse plus Delivery to Riyadh Delivery Team. The example is illustrative, not a finalized mapping table.

records.title: Installation service scope
records.text: Installation is a core After-Sales service involving appointment, technician, stage, products or quantities, completion status, partial installation, remaining installation, and likely customer confirmation depending on the final flow.

records.title: Installation stages with partial completion
records.text: A proposed installation stage flow is طلب تركيب to موعد to جاري التركيب to مكتمل. With partial completion, the proposed flow includes جاري التركيب to تكملة لاحقًا to موعد تكملة to جاري التركيب to مكتمل.

records.title: Goods readiness before installation
records.text: The system should check goods readiness before installation execution. If goods are incomplete, the system should handle the case as partial service instead of treating the full order as ready.

records.title: Partial installation and remaining quantity
records.text: Installation should support partial execution, such as installing 20 meters from 30 meters and keeping 10 meters as remaining, with an option for completion later.

records.title: Technician schedule conflict and buffer
records.text: The system should prevent overlapping technician appointments and support a travel buffer; the discussed example was a 30-minute gap between appointments.

records.title: Installation customer confirmation not finalized
records.text: Customer confirmation is mentioned as likely part of the final installation flow, but the source does not establish final confirmed behavior.

records.title: Measurement service exists
records.text: Measurement is one of the core After-Sales services and appears in Odoo model names close to decor_measurement and manufacturing_measurement.

records.title: Possible measurement purpose distinction
records.text: The source indicates a possible design distinction between decoration measurements and manufacturing measurements, with separate sequences for records, but detailed rules are not finalized.

records.title: Manufacturing in After-Sales flow
records.text: Manufacturing is part of the After-Sales flow for products that may not be ready directly after sale. The source mentions related objects such as manufacturing_measurement and manufacturing sequence.

records.title: High-level manufacturing dependency
records.text: A supported high-level flow is Sale to Measurement to Manufacturing to Warehouse or Readiness to Delivery to Installation, depending on product and service type.

records.title: Detailed manufacturing rules unavailable
records.text: The source explicitly says detailed business rules for manufacturing were not built to the same level as Delivery and Installation.

records.title: Design service exists
records.text: Design is listed as one of the core services in the customer after-sales journey.

records.title: High-level design-to-installation relationship
records.text: The educational service journey may include design to measurement to manufacturing to delivery to installation, depending on the scenario. Not every invoice necessarily passes through all of these services.

records.title: Detailed design rules unavailable
records.text: The source explicitly says detailed business rules for design were not built to the same level as Delivery and Installation.

records.title: Internal Transfer service nature
records.text: Internal Transfer is different from direct customer-facing services because it is more of an internal operation.

records.title: Internal Transfer as readiness dependency
records.text: Internal Transfer may be needed when goods are in one warehouse and the team executing the service belongs to another location. The high-level path is Product, Warehouse A, Internal Transfer, Warehouse B, then Delivery or Installation.

records.title: Internal Transfer UAT example J504 to J521
records.text: A UAT scenario used invoice INV/2026/00087 for Internal Transfer from J504 to J521. The task could be created manually. This is historical UAT evidence, not a universal business rule.

records.title: Locked fields in Internal Transfer UAT
records.text: During Internal Transfer testing, some fields were initially locked.

records.title: Field Maintenance service exists
records.text: Field Maintenance is included among the After-Sales services and is different from Installation because it typically starts after the product is already with the customer.

records.title: Conceptual Field Maintenance flow
records.text: The conceptual Field Maintenance flow is Customer Issue, Maintenance Request, Diagnosis, Technician Assignment, Appointment, Field Visit, Repair or Action, and Completion. Detailed business rules are not finalized.

records.title: Detailed Field Maintenance rules unavailable
records.text: The source explicitly says Field Maintenance is less defined and does not have final business rules at the same level of detail as Delivery and Installation.
